tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Find icons for a meaning or a UI action ("delete", "turn camera off", "invite user"). Ranked by the same engine as gentleface.com: names, meanings, synonyms and user phrasings, with notes on which icon to prefer. Search once per meaning you need.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: One icon in one style and format, with what it means, which icons to use instead, what it is confused with, file URLs (SVG, PNG 16/32/48), its family and, when it has one, its animated version (motion).

tools.name: get_icons
tools.description: Up to 30 icons in one style and format in one call: the way to fetch every icon a screen needs once you have picked them.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The categories of the set, with what each covers and how many icons it has.

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Every icon in one category (slug from list_categories), with what each is for.
